scope: Santa Marta, Colombia pilot only. Country selector retains all 18 countries; add other cities and listings as they are researched and approved.

streetFood.name: Mercado Público de Santa Marta
streetFood.description: A central traditional market with popular-food stalls serving Caribbean dishes, fresh juices, fried fish, cayeye, coconut rice, and other regional specialties. Visit in the morning and confirm vendor hours locally.
streetFood.cuisine: Samario and Caribbean market food, fresh juices, fish, cayeye
streetFood.photoNote: Illustrative food photo; not a verified photo of this market.

streetFood.name: Coctelería Juancho
streetFood.address: Santa Marta, Magdalena, Colombia — ask locally for the street stand's current location
streetFood.description: A long-running local street stand known for shrimp ceviche and seafood cocktails. Because street-vendor locations can shift, confirm the current spot before visiting.
streetFood.photoNote: Illustrative food photo; not a verified photo of this vendor.

streetFood.name: Arepas de Yiya's
streetFood.address: Santa Marta, Magdalena, Colombia — confirm the current stand location before visiting
streetFood.description: A locally featured stop for arepas, part of Santa Marta's lively street-food scene. Check the current location and hours before setting out.
streetFood.photoNote: Illustrative food photo; not a verified photo of this vendor.

streetFood.name: Bahía Juice Stalls
streetFood.address: Bahía waterfront, Santa Marta, Magdalena, Colombia
streetFood.description: A cluster of juice vendors serving refreshing drinks made with tropical fruit such as mango, lulo, corozo, and guanábana. Vendor selection and opening hours vary.
streetFood.photoNote: Illustrative drink photo; not a verified photo of this market.

streetFood.name: Taganga Malecón Street Food
streetFood.address: Malecón de Taganga, Taganga, Santa Marta, Magdalena, Colombia
streetFood.description: Explore informal coastal food spots and vendors around Taganga's waterfront for seafood, ceviche, and fresh-catch dishes. Confirm each vendor's availability and food handling on arrival.
streetFood.photoNote: Illustrative food photo; not a verified photo of this waterfront.

streetFood.name: El Rodadero Street Fritos & Snacks
streetFood.address: El Rodadero, Santa Marta, Magdalena, Colombia — vendor locations vary
streetFood.description: An area guide for evening street snacks including arepas de huevo, empanadas, patacones, and other fried bites. This is a vendor cluster, not one fixed stall; confirm which vendors are operating.
streetFood.cuisine: Arepas de huevo, empanadas, patacones, fritos
streetFood.photoNote: Illustrative food photo; not a verified photo of these vendors.

streetFood.name: Arepa e'huevo La Industrial — Donde Patricia
streetFood.address: Carrera 11 #15-1 to #15-51, Comuna 4, Santa Marta, Magdalena, Colombia
streetFood.description: A well-known traditional breakfast stop associated with the La Industrial arepa vendors. Specialties include freshly fried arepas de huevo and other coastal breakfast fritos. Go early; hours and exact stall position should be confirmed locally.
streetFood.cuisine: Arepas de huevo, coastal Colombian fritos
streetFood.photoNote: Illustrative food photo; not a verified photo of this vendor.

streetFood.name: Fritos Los Ángeles
streetFood.address: Carrera 6 #26A-21, Comuna 2, Santa Marta, Magdalena, Colombia
streetFood.description: Popular local fritos stop known for empanadas, papas rellenas, carimañolas, cheese fingers and other traditional Colombian fried snacks. Check current hours before visiting.
streetFood.cuisine: Colombian fritos, empanadas, papas rellenas, carimañolas
